component.name: Framewise
component.summary: Screen recorder, screenshots, text from the screen and clipboard history

description.p: Record an area, a window or the whole screen with sound and a camera bubble, then edit: cut silences and filler words, remove background noise, zoom on clicks, add a background, and save as MP4 or GIF.
Take screenshots and mark them up, copy text from any part of the screen, find anything you copied earlier, and use your camera as a mirror with background blur. Everything runs on your computer.
